title: Final reminder: your exclusive 20% food offer
preheader: The local business offer closes this week. Book before 31 October 2026 to receive 20% off food.

data.heading: Last call for your Christmas food offer
body: This is our final reminder: your exclusive email offer of 20% off food closes this week. Make your Christmas booking before 31 October 2026 to receive the discount.
We’re booking up fast for the festive season, and we want to prioritise local businesses wherever possible. Please tell us your preferred date and how we can help before the offer deadline passes.

Book before 31 October 2026 to receive 20% off food only. This email-only deal is exclusively for local businesses; drinks and other charges are excluded. Mention this email when you enquire so we can include the offer in your quote.

image.alt: A Christmas dinner at The Anchor: roast beef, a Yorkshire pudding, pigs in blankets, stuffing, roast potatoes, mash, peas and sprouts

data.heading: Let’s get your team’s celebration in the diary
body: Christmas dining runs from 10 November to 20 December. Tell us your rough numbers and what you have in mind, and we’ll help you explore the available options.
For Christmas dinner, a £10 deposit per person is taken at booking and deducted from your bill. Tell us your plans and we’ll confirm availability and the next steps.

data.body: An enquiry starts the conversation, but your booking needs to be made before 31 October to receive the discount. Mention this email when you get in touch.

data.reason_for_contact: You are receiving this because you enquired about a booking or an event with us, because you said we could get in touch, or because you are just down the road and we thought this would be useful. It may have been a while ago now, and it is good to still be in touch.
